notes.title: Update 8.1.0
notes.content:
[h3]One week into Season 8 and we’re ready for the first update! 
[/h3][p]The store update brings you the Hexscribe Set, which is bound to break your heart and your toys! Speaking of toys, a new ÖRF! collectable has entered the Arena and this time it’s Chubble Trouble the Goo Grenade! On top of that, it doesn’t matter if you like your weapons wrapped in barbed wire or dipped in Acrylic paint, there’s something for every Contestant! 

This week we also welcome two new flag bundles: Mexico and France! 
[/p][previewyoutube="g5rPQlOn0gw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We’re also getting ready for the Closed Qualifiers this weekend that will lead the winning teams to The Grand Major 2025! [u][url="https://www.reachthefinals.com/patchnotes/closedqualifiers2025"]Tune in and watch our talented hosts and casters[/url][/u] as they take us on this last step of the journey. The winners of this event will meet on the stage of The Grand Major at DreamHack Stockholm in November! 

Speaking of DreamHack, do you plan to be there for The Grand Major in Stockholm? If so, [u][url="https://forms.gle/TSRXsLkg1dnKsH3S6"]fill out this survey[/url][/u] so we can make plans to see you there! [i]If you already filled it out, please don’t do so again unless your plans have changed. [/i][/p][p]This update comes with a few additions and fixes, which you can read about below: 
[/p][h3][b]Content and Bug Fixes [/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Cosmetics & Customization[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updates to some facewear to increase compatibility with some headwear, for example, all gas masks will behave more like the newer versions[/p][/*][*][p]Wings will now work consistently and should not clip with upper body items as much[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Game Modes[/b][/p][p]Practice Range[/p][list][*][p]Added S7 trophies[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Performance & Stability[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed one of our most common client crashes [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Social[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed team chat not functioning properly after elimination, regardless of Instant Replay being enabled or disabled[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Creating a Dynamism Shooter
notes.content:
[p]When we started making THE FINALS, we wanted to bring together all the things we always loved in games: player choice and systemic design, deep interactivity, sandbox physics and destruction, and both playstyle and visual customization, and make them the foundation of the entire game. It was all about giving players agency, creativity, and the ability to shape their own experience. We gave this philosophy a name: Dynamism! 

In this episode of MAKING THE FINALS, our Creative Director, Gustav Tilleby Silow, explains Dynamism and walks us through the journey of making the world’s first Dynamism Shooter.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="hjUyrAGlHJI;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Packed with footage that dates back to the earliest days of Development, you'll learn what steps we took at Embark Studios to ensure that THE FINALS could live up to our dream of being a Dynamism-based shooter from the very beginning, to now.   Tune in! [/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 8.0.1
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hotfix 8.0.1 [/b]
[/h3][p]We’ve just deployed a hotfix to solve some of the unexpected issues introduced in Update 8.0.0. This includes the removal of the super jump that was created for the Light class!  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Content and Bug Fixes [/b][/h3][p][b]Cosmetics & Customization[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with the ‘Fuel to the Fire’ visual effect that caused it to be too long and sometimes clip into the player’s first-person camera view[/p][/*][*][p]FIxed a bug with the Black Nile Project Mask that could make your Character appear bare-chested in the main menu[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gadgets[/b][/p][p]H+ Infuser[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the H+ Infuser’s projectiles could be blocked by some objects, such as friendly Dome Shields[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reverted a change that has prevented players from quickly cancelling an animation after use, such as throwing a Frag Grenade, causing the item or projectile not to spawn[/p][p][i]Dev Note: In the 8.0 patch we made a change to better match the animation that plays when raising the Dematerializer control panel to the preview effect, to fix a common issue where players tried to quickly Dematerialize a surface but their first input didn’t count. Unfortunately, this fix had some unintended impacts so we have reverted that change, which means the old Dematerializer issue will be back until we find another approach. 

It should be noted here that separate to this change, we made a fix in 8.0 that causes deployables’ preview meshes to only appear when the player is allowed to deploy them. This should make it more reliable to deploy, and avoid that old feeling that the input was being ignored because the mesh showed up too early. [b]The ‘time to deploy’ for these items is still the same as prior to 8.0[/b], this is just a visual change and it is not related to the revert mentioned above. [/i]
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Specializations[/b][/p][p]Evasive Dash[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where hitting jump immediately after dashing would cause a ‘super-dash’ to occur, sending the player much further than intended[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Weapons[/b][/p][p]Dagger[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where releasing the secondary attack early, before fully charged, could cause distorted and stuck sound effects[/p][/*][/list][p]Pike-556[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Pike had the wrong headshot bonus. It now gives the correct x1.5 damage bonus[/p][/*][/list][p]Sword[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where releasing the secondary attack early, before fully charged, could cause distorted and stuck sound effects[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Season 8 is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1][b]SEASON 8 | GAME TIME [/b][/h1][h2][i][b]THE WORLD IS WATCHING[/b][/i][b] [/b][/h2][p]It’s time to unite! This is the main event, Contestants. With all eyes on the grandest of stages, if there ever was a moment to play your best, this is it. The game is on. The greatest gameshow on Earth is back for another season! This is THE FINALS.

Flags will fly, cultures will shine, and Contestants from all over the globe will step into the spotlight for a showdown of epic proportions! The Arena is set, revamped, and ready to host the World's biggest competition![i] It's GAME TIME![/i][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="wtubUGD2M-4;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][url="https://www.reachthefinals.com/patchnotes/800"]For a more complete version of the Notes, visit the News Page![/url][b] 

INSTANT REPLAY[/b][/h3][p][b] 
[/b]Instant Replay Beta has landed and it's nothing short of magical!  Want to know what just turned you into a pile of coins? Now you can! This is mind-bending tech that fuses destruction physics, dynamic environments, and fast-paced action into a full clip, live, and just for you.[/p][p]This feature is rolling out in beta as we learn from it. It’s technically wild, and we’re beyond proud. It plays back your elimination moments so you can actually see what happened in that fast-moving, destructible chaos we call THE FINALS. The clarity it delivers is game-changing.[/p][p]To be honest, at first and second glance, this was an impossible task. But at Embark we take a challenge seriously. Prototypes for this feature date back to the early days of the project, before THE FINALS even had a name, trying to prove it possible. What you will see in Season 8 is the result of all that hard work. We had to calculate everything that matters: player movement, environmental destruction, object interactions in a level of data fidelity that’s hard to pull off in a Dynamism Shooter. Then take all that info and quickly reconstruct the moment. [/p][p]It’s not enabled for everyone by default (especially on systems under 16 GB RAM), but you can toggle it on manually. If you’ve got the horsepower, turn it on, try it, and tell us what you think. We’ll be gathering feedback, polishing performance, and expanding integration throughout the season.[/p][p]In THE FINALS, the Arena is a living, crumbling, ever-changing beast. Instant Replay offers a path to smarter plays and sharper instincts.[b] [/b]Give it a try! [/p][h3][/h3][h3][b]MATCH RECAP [/b][/h3][p]We’re rolling out a brand-new match summary screen for World Tour, Ranked and QuickCash, with more Modes to come. It features a timeline graph of important scoring events. You’ll also see a personal breakdown of your own performance, with ratings across Combat, Support, Objective score, and more. You’ll see how it all played out and your own contribution to the team effort! 

Rise to the challenge and aim to be spectacular! And should you successfully end a round with nothing but S-ranks across the board, tag us and let us know!
[/p][h3][b]WEAPONS OLD AND NEW [/b][/h3][p][b]Season 8 comes with two new Weapons that are bound to change the game in new and exciting ways: [/b][/p][p][b]BFR TITAN | Heavy [/b][/p][p]The BFR Titan is a high caliber, manual action revolver that deals immense damage. With its low ammo count and individually reloaded rounds, it's ideal for those who want to hold the edge of the encounter and pick off their targets, one bullet at a time.
[b]
P90 | Medium 
[/b]The P90 is a submachine gun with a compact design and high capacity magazine. Unload a barrage at shorter ranges, or pester targets from further away by raining bullets! Get ready to spray and pray, contestants![/p][p][/p][p][b]Weapons System 
[/b]We’re also migrating more weapons over to our new Weapons System, which is way more robust and reliable than the old one! This is a long-term initiative and we’re taking it step-by-step to make sure this first phase is done right. Several Weapons are migrating over to the new system and more will make the move during Season 8. It is our ambition to finally put an end to some of the longest standing weapon related bugs in THE FINALS,  once and for all.[/p][p][b]Dematerializer Improvements [/b][/p][p]We’ve reworked the Dematerializer to be more reliable when opening and closing segments and to provide a more accurate aim when it comes to aiming your wall removal. We’ve also added an off-screen indicator that will help other Contestants know when a wall has been opened nearby to them. 
[/p][p][b]Grenade Indicator [/b][/p][p]Watch out! We’ve added a Frag Grenade indicator for better readability on your imminent detonation, players should now have a bit more time to react to live Grenades. This has been a requested feature for some time, watch your six and stay safe out there, Contestants!  [/p][h3][b]SMOOTH DESTRUCTION [/b][/h3][p]Welcome to the first release of a feature we’re calling [b]Smooth Destruction.[/b] Until recently, impact damage from collapsing structures wasn’t really there. With this new update, we’re dialing up the cascading damage that can occur when buildings or objects fall into others. Starting with suspended structures and cranes, making these crash down can cause real damage and totally reshape the environment, creating new emergent play spaces in the process! [/p][p]Smooth destruction introduces knock-on effects and chain reactions that open up new tactical and strategic options. It’s a fundamental leap forward, and further proof that evolving our core systems can transform the Arena just as much as brand-new features.[/p][p]This is only the beginning! We plan to keep pushing the boundaries and spreading Smooth Destruction across every Arena in new and exciting ways! [/p][p]This is something we have wanted and planned for since day one, so seeing it live in the game is humbling and exciting all at the same time! Have fun tearing it all down, Contestants![/p][p][b]KYOTO UPGRADES[/b]
Destruction keeps evolving across the Arenas, and Kyoto is the latest to get an upgrade. Buildings now collapse into connected chunks of debris that are easier to climb and traverse. Collapses happen closer to where structures were weakened, so it’s easier to anticipate what’s going to fall. The new setup is also more optimized, so performance gets a boost too.[/p][p]But that’s not all, Kyoto has also received design improvements. Extra jump pads have been added to provide faster access to key areas, and reduce the need for movement gadgets. Interior layouts have been simplified, and basements have been split up with walls to provide more cover and tactical opportunities. Expect more changes to come as we work on tackling even more of the pain points! [/p][p][b]MONACO AND MORE
[/b]We’ve applied what we’ve learned from our more recent maps to Monaco’s suspended structures. They’re now built as larger gameplay spaces with improved accessibility, creating more room for action and better flow.[/p][p]Across all maps, you’ll now see new branding that amps up the excitement of the Competition. Just like when the Olympics or World Cup takes over a city, every Arena is being transformed with fresh banners and energy![/p][p]Even the stadium itself is evolving; stands and structures will change throughout the season, building up towards the Major, where the full transformation will be revealed…[/p][h3][b]SIGN YOUR SPONSOR[/b] [/h3][p]
It’s time for a new Sponsor deal and this Season, you’ll be choosing between two giants! [/p][h3][b]HOLTOW | [/b][i]Digitally insured, virtually secured. [/i][/h3][p]HOLTOW is back for another Season, vying for your Loyalty and dedicated to your protection! They even have an all new insurance type to offer the wayward souls of the meatspace and virtual world alike. CEO, Quemby Rutile, is ready to back any Contestant willing to wear the HOLTOW name with pride. If you’re a returning HOLTOW signer, get ready for a whole new track of rewards that will deepen your dedication and your protection! [/p][p][b]SIGN WITH HOLTOW AND INSURE YOUR VICTORY![/b] [/p][p][/p][h3][b]TRENTILA | [/b][i]Slightly unstable. Shockingly good. [/i][/h3][p]CEO Ana Del Mar has been tilling the soil of the Arena for a long time now, but this is the first time TRENTILA steps up into the spotlight and offers support to Contestants as an official Sponsor of THE FINALS! They are here to prove that they can nurture more than just agriculture, and promise that signees will bloom in the spotlight that they cast!  If they can grow their trademarked Tiger Fruit in the middle of the Transatlantic Landfill, they can certainly grow your fame and fortune! [/p][p][b]SIGN WITH TRENTILA AND CULTIVATE YOUR TRIUMPH![/b] [/p][h3][b]BATTLE PASS [/b][/h3][p]The Season 8 Battle Pass is full of earnable rewards designed to celebrate the spirit of global competition in a spirited and fantastical way!  You can choose between the Ultimate, Premium, or Free Battle Pass which means there is something for everyone! [/p][h3][b]PLAYSTYLES [/b][/h3][p]We’re introducing [b]Playstyles[/b]: pre-made Contestant templates that bundle a Specialization, Weapon, and Gadgets into a recognizable style of play. They give new players a clear starting point and show off the variety THE FINALS has to offer, while still letting everyone branch out and experiment with their own personal Loadout and Playstyles. This will make THE FINALS friendlier for new players and will also provide a much faster path for unlocking Weapons, Specializations, and Gadgets! [/p][p]Want the full breakdown? Check out the [url="https://www.reachthefinals.com/patchnotes/playstyles"][u]Playstyles blog[/u][/url] for all the details.[/p][p][b]MORE IMPROVEMENTS FOR NEWBIES [/b][/p][p][b]Tutorial Updates
[/b]The tutorial has been expanded to cover so much more of what makes THE FINALS, THE FINALS! It now teaches players how to use Specializations, what happens during a team wipe, and how to revive teammates. After completing a revive, you’ll even get a Dummy teammate to help finish things out. This should help new players gain a stronger foundation before their first real match.[/p][p][b]New Dummy Challenges
[/b]We’ve added more Dummy Challenges in the Practice Range, focused around playing the objective. In one, you’ll defend a Cashout from waves of Dummies trying to steal it, perfect practice for the chaos of the Arena.[/p][p][b]Rookie Contracts
[/b]Rookie Contracts return as a fuller onboarding experience. Now they include tasks like completing the tutorial, finishing Challenges, creating your first Contestant, and trying out different Game Modes. They give new players a longer runway to explore the game and plenty of incentives along the way.[/p][h3][b]FASTER BOOT TIMES[/b][/h3][p]We’ve added background shader pre-compilation, which means the game client boots up much faster. You’ll be able to navigate menus, edit Contestants,  and party up with friends while shaders finish compiling in the background. For machines that normally spend a lot of time stuck on precompiling shaders, this change should make a big difference. [/p][p][b]Ranked Reconnect Improvements
[/b]We’re adjusting the rules for Ranked Tournament abandonment. Combined with faster boot times, this means players who need to reconnect during a ranked match won’t be unfairly penalized just because the client took too long to restart.[/p][h3][b]CUSTOMIZATION IMPROVEMENTS [/b][/h3][p][b]Earrings
[/b]That’s right, get ready for Earrings! It’s time to find new ways to sparkle! Nothing complements a beautiful set of hair, stylish glasses, a well trimmed beard, and a fresh coat of makeup like a pair of diamond studs covering your sides![/p][p][b]Effects 
[/b]We’ve separated item effects from items, so cosmetics that come with signature character effects that modify the space around them, no longer rely on that piece in order to apply the effect! [/p][h3][b]GAME MODES [/b][/h3][p][b]Head2Head is here to stay! 
[/b]Head2Head is no longer a limited event. It’s joining our Quick Play modes. We saw a lot of love for this Mode and we think it’s a great warm up round or pick when you don’t have time to make it to the final round of a Tournament! [/p][p][b]Team Deathmatch on Bernal
[/b]As part of our efforts to enhance existing features, we’re adding Team Deathmatch to Bernal, giving players a fresh way to experience the map. Get ready to fight across three signature areas in this magical town: Hotels, Apartments, Backyards![/p][p][b]Saying Goodbye to Terminal Attack 
[/b]For now, it’s time to say goodbye to Terminal Attack. It’s by far our least played Mode and its fraught history makes the Mode difficult to love. Maybe it’ll return one day as an event, once we’re all good and ready! [b] [/b][/p][h3][b]NEW SOUNDTRACK [/b][/h3][p]It wouldn’t be a new Season without a new set of Bangers from our unbelievably talented Audio team![/p][p]Audio Director, Carl Strandberg, says, [i]“This season we really wanted to hit home on the Olympic grandness of the Major coming up. So it's very much inspired by everything majestic. We've really tried incorporating a lot of orchestral elements, tying it together with the classic FINALS-synth and drum sounds, but also trying to get elements from every previous season in there, to build on everything we've created the last 7 seasons.”[/i][/p][h3][b]MOUSE AND KEYBOARD FOR CONSOLE [/b][/h3][p]You can now play with Mouse and Keyboard on Console! [/p][h3][b]TWITCH DROPS [/b][/h3][p]Abby the APS is excited to join her friends Terry and Chuck! Available now for FREE as a Twitch drop, along with a sticker and a pair of Earrings that will help keep Abby close to your heart and mind at all times! Watch any Twitch streamer playing THE FINALS with drops enabled to earn your new best friend! While the new handy Frag Grenade indicator will alert you of an incoming Grenade, Abby will kindly, but firmly, decline its explosive power.[/p][h3][b]THE GRAND MAJOR 2025[/b][/h3][p]With The Arenas set for the grandest competitions, we’re also setting the grand stage for our first ever esports Major! The 16 strongest teams across the world will travel to DreamHack Stockholm to settle the score and see who’s truly the best of the best, and will be crowned Champion of The Arena![/p][p]Our Closed Qualifiers featuring full studio production, top talent from the community and the strongest 16 teams from EMEA and NA takes place on September 20th & 21st, where we will find out which teams qualify through to The Grand Major![/p][p]See you in Stockholm, Contestants![/p][p]Now, let’s get into all the nitty gritty details: [/p][h2][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h2][p][b]Gadgets [/b][/p][p]Frag Grenade[/p][list][*][p]Added in-world grenade indicator[/p][/*][/list][p]H+ Infuser[/p][list][*][p]Decreased healing per shot from 15 to 14[/p][p][i]Dev Note: The Infuser was still slightly outperforming other healing items, this change is made to address that.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]Thermal Vision[/p][list][*][p]Temporarily disabled Thermal Vision[/p][p][i]Dev Note: Thermal Vision has struggled with a considerable number of bugs and issues for some time now, issues that are not a simple or quick thing to fix. Some issues can offer players an unintended advantage, so we’ve made the decision to bench the Gadget for now. We’ll re-work it over the next few seasons, at which point it will return to the roster. [/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the damage done by the crane’s wrecking ball from 10 to 75[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Specializations[/b]
[/p][p]Dematerializer [/p][list][*][p]Decreased the number of charges from 3 to 2[/p][/*][*][p]Added new functionality which now remembers exactly which wall segments were dematerialized when a charge was used. These segments are now grouped together and if any of them is rematerialized, all of those in the group will also always be rematerialized[/p][/*][*][p]Added a vignette to the screen that will be displayed when a wall segment is dematerialized near the player, just outside of their field of view, so that players are better aware of what is happening around them[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the dematerialize effect on walls when activated, adding a slight delay before the wall segment becomes fully transparent[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new ‘vibration’ effect to dematerialized wall segments, which will start to play just before the wall segments would automatically rematerialize[/p][p][i]Dev Note: These changes have been a long time coming. The Dematerializer Specialization has been [b]by far [/b]the most picked Specialization and the most winning, across the majority of modes and skill tiers. We never intended any item to see so much usage and it has sped up the pace of the game and how quickly Cashout fights resolve. Our intent has been to reduce the number of charges available, to throttle the usage rate, but we felt we couldn’t make that change until we fixed how unreliable opening and closing wall segments could be. With this new system and the improved visual feedback, we’re now in a place where we can reduce the ammo count. Between this change and the Turret and Healing Beam buffs, we’re hoping to return to a more varied Medium meta.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]Guardian Turret[/p][list][*][p]Decreased the cooldown from 40s to 35s[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the cooldown when retrieving the turret from 20s to 17.5s[/p][p][i]Dev Note: As Specializations go, the Turret has been fairly underused. We want to increase its desirability without making it too frustrating. This change will buff its availability in-match. [/i]
[/p][/*][/list][p]Healing Beam[/p][list][*][p]Increased healing rate from 40 per second to 46 per second[/p][p][i]Dev Note: Since the Healing Beam is a Specialization, it should be one of the more desirable healing tools in the game, Since the introduction of the  H+ Infuser and the Healing Emitter (a.k.a Chuck), it’s not been desirable enough. This change allows the Healing Beam to go from 220 to 253 healing before overheating, which should buff it to where it should be.[/i]
[/p][/*][/list][p]Winch Claw[/p][list][*][p]Increased cooldown when missing a target from 7s to 10s[/p][/*][*][p]Increased cooldown when successfully hitting a Cashout Station or Contestant from 14s to 18s[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the cooldown when hitting all other object types from 7s to 14s[/p][p][i]Dev Note: The power and impact of the Winch Claw is out of line with some of the other Heavy Specializations and that is reflected in the data.[/i]
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Weapons [/b][/p][p].50 Akimbo[/p][list][*][p]Decreased damage falloff minimum range from 35m to 32m, giving the weapon a slightly shorter effective range[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased damage falloff max range from 42.5m to 39m, giving the weapon a slightly shorter effective range[/p][p][i]Dev Note: We feel the akimbo pistols are performing slightly too well at longer ranges, so this is a small nudge to bring them more into their intended niche. [/i][/p][/*][/list][p]CB-01[/p][list][*][p]Increased damage from 84 to 88[/p][p][i]Dev Note: The CB-01 has struggled to perform well across most modes and sees a very low pick rate. This change is intended to improve viability. [/i]
[/p][/*][/list][p]Dual Blades[/p][list][*][p]Increased how quickly sprinting is re-enabled after the second attack animation begins by 25%[/p][/*][*][p]Increased how quickly sprinting is re-enabled after the third attack animation begins by 15%[/p][p][i]Dev Notes: This change is mostly to correct some inconsistencies between attacks, which made the second animation in the attack sequence more aggressively slow the player than it should have.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]LH1[/p][list][*][p]Increased damage from 42 to 44[/p][p][i]Dev Note: We’re still trying to get the LH1 to a place where it’s viable but not dominant. Previous changes have seen it really bottom out in both usage and performance, so we’re nudging it in an effort to improve viability and desirability. [/i]
[/p][/*][/list][p]Pike-556[/p][list][*][p]Decreased damage from 50 to 48[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased damage falloff minimum range from 45m to 40m, giving the weapon a slightly shorter effective range[/p][/*][*][p]Increased damage falloff multiplier from 0.75 to 0.8, meaning the weapon now does slightly more damage at range. This is somewhat offset by the reduction in base damage[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the size of bullet dispersion when firing from the hip, especially while crouching, making the weapon less accurate when not aiming down sights[/p][p][i]Dev Note: We feel the Pike currently has too much utility, being both good at long range but also very viable at close range. These changes aim to get it to where it should be, a medium-to-long range rifle that is less effective when fighting at close quarters.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]Riot Shield[/p][list][*][p]Decreased maximum speed of an attack’s lunge to the target from 10m/s to 7m/s[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased minimum speed of an attack’s lunge to the target from 7m/s to 5.5m/s[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the trigger range of the attack’s lunge from 4m to 2.5m[/p][p][i]Dev Note: The recent buffs to melee, including the Riot Shield, exposed some pre-existing issues, including its ability to too reliably keep attackers on top of enemies once they reached them. These changes should address that.  [/i]
[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Content and Bug Fixes 
[/b][/h2][p][b]Animation[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Sword's secondary charge-up animation was sometimes not shown correctly in spectator view[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the first-person view of the Riot Shield. You will now have a better sense of where your shield is blocking when aiming up and down[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a small but noticeable inconsistency when aiming down sights after sprinting in first-person. This should now better match the visual effects of the smoke[/p][/*][/list][p]Sonar Grenade[/p][list][*][p]Increased hitbox size to make it easier to destroy by shooting[/p][/*][/list][p]Proximity Sensor[/p][list][*][p]Increased hitbox size to make it easier to destroy by shooting[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Game Modes[/b][/p][p]General[/p][list][*][p]Removed Terminal Attack from Quickplay and Private Matches[/p][/*][*][p]Added Head2Head to Quickplay and Private Matches[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Bank It! from Private Matches[/p][p][i]Dev note: While we still see lots of love for Bank It! in the community, it hasn’t been played often enough in Private Matches to warrant the overhead it brings when it comes to regular maintenance, QA testing, etc.. It will likely return in another format some day in the future! [/i][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the abandoned check did not work as intended. Players are now only marked as abandoned if they’ve actually left and are no longer tracked by the connection system. We’ll be keeping an eye out to ensure this behaves correctly[/p][/*][/list][p]Practice Range[/p][list][*][p]Added two new challenges: Cashout Defense and Cashbox Time-Trial[/p][/*][*][p]Added a 4th version of the Meet the Dummies challenge where you’ll meet all three Dummies at the same time[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Dummy behavior to enable them to fight back against some Gadgets and seconds to give players more time to rejoin mid-match[/p][/*][/list][p]TDM[/p][list][*][p]Added Bernal to the map pool[/p][/*][/list][p]Tutorial [/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Nama Tama hint could become stuck [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enabled Smooth Destruction for the Crane, Wrecking Ball, and Suspended Structures[/p][/*][*][p]Gadget previews are now better aligned with actual usability timing, preventing missed inputs in the Arena [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where sounds and visual effects would occur in the Arena without any player nearby [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where elimination hitmarkers would sometimes fail to display[/p][/*][/list][p][b]GameShow Events[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Dead Go Boom Gameshow Event is now enabled on all Maps and Modes where Events are available[/p][/*][*][p]Alien Invasion has been adjusted to target objectives when applicable and lift up players[/p][p][i]Dev note: we're looking into a bug where UFOs don’t avoid collision with none-playable buildings, which once squashed, will allow us to enable the updated Alien Invasion on more maps in the near future.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Languages[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Russian localization to the game[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Maps[/b][/p][p]General[/p][list][*][p]All Suspended Structures will now use the new Smooth Destruction feature which allows them to destroy the environment underneath them when they fall[/p][/*][*][p]Updated crane visuals to allow players to vault to top part of crane more easily when the cabin ladder is broken[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where shooting at text or decals on windows would need more bullets to be fired in order to break the glass.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced scale of goo and smoke ATK Canisters to minimise players getting stuck on them[/p][/*][/list][p]Bernal[/p][list][*][p]Fix for player movement issues on curved metallic slanted roof[/p][/*][*][p]Added a short ladder to the area in front of the Chapel courtyard[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the zipline in the courtyard next to the Chapel for smoother exiting in multiple directions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collision complexity on a low tree to fix issues with player revives[/p][/*][/list][p]Fortune Stadium[/p][list][*][p]Fix for player getting accidentally stuck beneath ground of ISEUL-T buildings when falling through[/p][/*][/list][p]Kyoto[/p][list][*][p]Added several Jump Pads between Temples and Villa Compound to make the Villa Compound easier to attack, improve the Macro Flow, and reduce the need for movement gadgets.[/p][/*][*][p]Added cover and reworked the layouts of all basements in Kyoto to make them more varied and interesting to fight in. We also removed as many “floating” pillars as we were structurally able to, to make navigation easier - particularly during combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the amount of basement entrances, to reduce the number of engagement angles you have to cover at once.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed all Cashout Stations inside the Bamboo Forest as prolonged combat proved too problematic in such a dense, natural environment.[/p][/*][*][p]Nearly all buildings in Kyoto have seen small interior layout tweaks to reduce their overall complexity. The aim is to make them easier to navigate and quicker understand at a glance.[/p][p][i]Dev Note: Kyoto’s architecture and building sizes naturally lean towards denser and tighter layouts, especially when compared to our other maps. With this pass we want to simplify and open the spaces up a bit more without compromising its theming or gameplay intent.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Residential - Added a Zipline to allow for rooftop access without the need for movement gadgets[/p][/*][*][p]Pavilion - Objectives have been moved to the sides of the building, to ensure fights happen in the flanks, not the center of the structure. [/p][/*][*][p]Pavilion - Ground floor layout has been adjusted to reduce the amount of 360 fights[/p][/*][*][p]Added Zipline between Guest House and Residential to improve macro flow and reduce the need for movement gadgets [/p][/*][*][p]Added ladder from Entrance to Guest House as an alternative shortcut [/p][/*][*][p]Small Guest House - Added ladder to the rooftop to allow for easier access without needing movement gadgets. Also added a small veranda to subdivide the space and add some cover for combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Training Quarters - Added more dividing doors to better define chokepoints [/p][/*][*][p]Training Quarters back building - broke up the corridor and moved the Cashout Station into the other room to make fights more directional. Removed the Cashout Station that was on the exterior veranda as those fights proved too chaotic.[/p][/*][*][p]Added several planks around the map to highlight and open up new traversal opportunities[/p][/*][*][p]Villa Compound Garden - Added a Jump Pad on the south side of the Tea House to help players escape precarious situations more easily[/p][/*][*][p]Villa Compound Tea House - Moved and rotated slightly to frame the new Jump Pad better. Its layout has been subdivided to improve combat longevity [/p][/*][*][p]Hillside House - Interior has been simplified to reduce its navigation complexity and  better support defending the most common approach angles[/p][/*][*][p]Main Temple - Interior layout has been reworked to make taking control over its spaces easier and fights less 360/chaotic[/p][/*][*][p]Vault updates and additions all over the map to facilitate more “stand-off” encounters between competing teams[/p][/*][*][p]Many small QoL tweaks to the flow and readability of Kyoto[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for indestructible stone fence modules on exterior staircase area[/p][/*][*][p]Kyoto destruction re-work that make structure collapses result in debris that is more traversable and less chaotic[/p][/*][/list][p]Las Vegas 2032 & Stadium[/p][list][*][p]Added more player spawn points and adjusted a few[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a duplicate Zipline in the staircase of Alfa Acta building[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a ladder floating above the roof of Glamora casino[/p][/*][/list][p]Monaco[/p][list][*][p]Suspended Structures map variant has been reworked[/p][p][i]Dev note:The previous version could severely restrict players who didn't have the right items to contest the suspended structures, and it lacked meaningful variation between the different setups across the map. With this rework we aim to enable a larger variety of strategies and playstyles, whilst also offering a more balanced experience between attackers and defenders.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Fix for collision of cathedral pillar piece on duck and cover variant to be more predictable with player movement and gadgets[/p][/*][*][p]Added more player spawn points and adjusted a few[/p][/*][*][p]Added new Vault locations[/p][/*][*][p]Added new Cashout Station on the crane[/p][/*][*][p]Added ladders on the sides of a few buildings to make it easier to traverse between rooftops[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the cliffs at the edge of the Forest to make it easier to climb up the walls in a couple places[/p][/*][/list][p]Nozomi/Citadel[/p][list][*][p]Added some more cover along The Rift between Cybercafe and Apartments[/p][/*][/list][p]Skyway Stadium[b] [/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed floating zebra crossing in the residential district[/p][/*][*][p]Added more player spawn points and adjusted a few[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted backdrop building to prevent crane clipping issues on Skyway Stadium[/p][/*][/list][p]Seoul[/p][list][*][p]Added more player spawn points and adjusted a few[/p][/*][*][p]Moved a hospital bed away from a window where you could easily get stuck between the two[/p][/*][/list][p]SYS$HORIZON[/p][list][*][p]Added more player spawn points and adjusted a few[/p][/*][/list][p]Tutorial[/p][list][*][p]Improved Tutorial flow to include more scenarios and better teach the basics of gameplay [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Matchmaking[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated the matchmaker to put more emphasis on separating premade parties and solo players in matches for World Tour, Powershift and QuickCash[/p][p][i]Dev note: This change is possible due to new functionality we’ve added to the matchmaker, that gives us more flexible ways to make matches. As it’s relatively new and requires quite a bit of testing, it’s only being rolled out for these modes to start with, but it’s our aim to move all modes to this system in the near future [/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Performance & Stability[/b][/p][list][*][p]Moved shader compilation to in-game rather than startup[b] [/b][/p][p][i]Dev note: Moved shader preloading to frontend, allowing players to customize their loadout, visit the shop and adjust settings while waiting for it to complete. If a player attempts to start a game before preloading has finished, a warning is shown. The warning can be ignored if the player prefers to start immediately and risk performance issues.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Private Matches & Spectator[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added the ability to change color and assign preset team names to teams in private matches[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Rendering[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that could cause pixelated artifacts around the edges of your contestant in the Main Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused light flickering when changing Effects quality setting in-game[/p][/*][*][p]Made changing NVIDIA RTX Global Illumination setting more responsive in-game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare issue that caused the 3D scene to flicker and show up cropped incorrectly in the top left corner[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing jittering red dot and holographic sights when AMD FSR3 Frame Generation was enabled.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Social[/b][/p][list][*][p]Moved block management to in-game instead of web based [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Specializations[/b][/p][p]Dematerializer[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue when trying to rematerialize a section that has just been dematerialized would incorrectly consume ammo[/p][/*][/list][p]Winch Claw[/p][list][*][p]Improving winch claw hit detection by making sure the hooking player has some visibility over the enemy it's trying to hook.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the incorrect weapon skin was highlighted as you entered the skin screen for weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Fix player card customization menu resetting to the selected Contestant when opened from gamepad[/p][/*][*][p]You can now inspect rewards in the contract screen[/p][/*][*][p]Wishlist prices will now update correctly when adding items to your cart and updating your already existing wishlist[/p][/*][*][p]Allow toggling HUD in PracticeRange/Tutorial via F10 key[/p][/*][*][p]Now you can easily equip gadgets, specializations, and weapons directly from the equipment screen![/p][/*][*][p]Added specialization icon to contestant pack icons in frontend[/p][/*][*][p]"Playstyles" tab has been added to the equipment screen[/p][/*][*][p]"Playstyle Token" currency has been added to the top bar, which only displays if the player has unlockable playstyles remaining. Clicking on this currency will open the playstyles tab. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]VFX[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with the elimination coin effect that could make it disappear too early[/p][/*][*][p]Updated visuals for the Gas Canister explosion[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Weapons[/b][/p][p]Sights[/p][list][*][p]Setup for Magnifex Sight on all weapons that support Reflector Sight[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3 new sights to various guns:[/p][list][*][p]Iron Vantage - An alternate, high magnification scope added to:[/p][list][*][p]Pike-556[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Quickspark - A red dot sight for handguns added to:[/p][list][*][p]- R .357[/p][/*][*][p]- BFR Titan[/p][/*][*][p]- V9S[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Magnifex - A box holographic with moderate magnification added to:[/p][list][*][p]- XP-54[/p][/*][*][p]- FCAR[/p][/*][*][p]- FAMAS[/p][/*][*][p]- LH1[/p][/*][*][p]- CB-01 Repeater[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed the visual misalignment of the 'Looking Glass' scope with the Shak-50 weapon model[/p][/*][/list][p]Dual Blades[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where dual blades would sometime not play deflect animation when deflecting a turret projectile[/p][/*][/list][p]Riot Shield[/p][list][*][p]Fixed several instances of animation desync of the Riot Shield in third person, zig zag sprints, ziplines and aiming should now all be more accurate to where the collision is situated[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the setup in first person to better represent the collision state both in guarded and non guarded state[/p][p][i]Dev note: We have made another animation pass on the Riot Shield to improve the visuals so they better match the collision state. While this improvement does obstruct some of your vision in the left field of view, it does give both the wielder and the attacker a better understanding of which bullets will hit the shield, and which will hit the character. There are still some issues left to solve and we have another update cooking that will improve this even further, but we felt that instead of holding off changes we’d opt for a middle step that will improve things overall. [/i][/p][/*][/list][p]Spear[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where being Winch Clawed while using the secondary attack of the Spear would prevent using that attack again for a few seconds
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Security [/b][/p][p][i]Updates from the Anti-Cheat team!
[/i][/p][p]Our technical test of Denuvo for XBox on Windows was successful.[/p][p]As a result we will start an incremental rollout on Steam for Season 8.[/p][p]We know there have been concerns about us choosing Denuvo from Irdeto, and we'd like to re-iterate that we're not using their Digital Rights Management service. We are working closely with the game team to ensure minimal impact on performance, and trust us, they drive a hard bargain![/p][p]In order to keep up with cheaters, we are always on the lookout for new solutions, so aside from Denuvo we have a couple more exciting updates.[/p][p]We have asked VAIIYA to build a solution for us, which is a complicated and time consuming effort. It’s still very much a work in progress, so stay tuned for updates.[/p][p]We have also partnered up with Anybrain, and have rolled out their solution to a small percentage of our playerbase as a test with plans to continue throughout Season 8. Evaluations are ongoing and this may become a permanent part of our toolbox to protect fair play and the integrity of our players. [/p][p]/// Tom and Magnum[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Store Update 7.11 - Cardbored to Death!
notes.content: [h2][b]Store Update 7.11.0 [/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Welcome to all the new players who have been entering the Arena lately! And thank you to all the veteran Contestants who have been welcoming them and showing them the ropes. Don’t forget to take advantage of the [b]Recruit and Rise[/b] program, that will help both Recruiters and Prospects gain cool rewards, bragging rights, and a nice smooth introduction to THE FINALS! [/p][p]We’re hard at work on Season 8, but this week, we’ve got a new addition to the store.[/p][previewyoutube="dZagEWJBV7c;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Out of ideas? Never. Out of materials? Maybe.[/p][p]Cardbored to Death is this week’s beautifully corrugated addition to the storefront, a full set of improvised armor, duct tape and all, for the contestant who crafts chaos from cardboard. Built for budget, styled for battle. The Folded Line Model skin brings paper-cut precision, or maybe cardboard bluntness, to every takedown. And if pixels are more your thing, the 8-bit Blades Set slices its way into the store. Forged in a low-res world for high-stakes play, these retro-inspired Dual Blades pair nostalgia with impact.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]THE CLASH FOR CASH CONTINUES[/b] [/h3][p]The final countdown is ticking down on the HEAD 2 HEAD event! Sponsors are watching, so do them proud and bring home the Season victory! Starting today, you have new contracts to unlock, new rewards to earn, and as always, fame within your grasp.[/p]

notes.title: Update 7.9 - HEAD2HEAD feat. Ned
notes.content:
[h1][b]Update 7.9.0[/b][/h1][p][/p][h3][b]MONSTER ALERT![/b][/h3][p][b][img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfWib7xl0s4XK3VdHR9GN54_mokeBwopZsTPH6760JpQ9o7i7oM0yjDAwFj3sZWoPl7yMg6de8qxARdE5_RVIO4fu2_bm3PjQZhA90VZU20xl_4pBIkr9j-NFIIv3iCZvAgc5coKg?key=Jq8Ev3vznPgfbzKi2UIk6Q"][/img][/b][/p][p]Welcome to the monstrous end-of-season showdown! We’re introducing a new Limited-Time mode called [b]Head 2 Head[/b], which pits Sponsor against Sponsor in the final round of Cashout! Earn free Event rewards for completing Contracts and grab a full set of VAIIYA and CNS themed skins! [/p][p]Head 2 Head captures that Final Round experience, a 3v3 round where Respawns are faster and unlimited. Look out for an [b]all new Gameshow Event, [/b]the Nedstrike, that will have you fleeing in terror! [/p][p][/p][p][b][img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeaHZMaMTaWOSLot9femaDgfwBDJY6UO085VC0GDV0vWHo5v9C7CPBGEyCqUOsnUj2urk86GI4r6Uhhaunqr_9DnFLzkIis0LJLhw1qIMfTCqO4gxaetZxvIWvaapgBGVYRPYIaSA?key=Jq8Ev3vznPgfbzKi2UIk6Q"][/img][/b][/p][p]Complete Event Contracts to get free rewards! [/p][h3][b]XP OVERRIDE [/b][/h3][p][b][img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXclKx-HJjaQ0qlS_Qt1A7KKuZix-bsk9U249-oQNkmOG88V7A2yC3bQEVZF6vDaR7yTvMZkZa8oCPwvhdNGAlEzT3vUl6qjwSx_8IUTUFG-k4f28t4yR9Jvb-sJ-5FOrzUT6wUa?key=Jq8Ev3vznPgfbzKi2UIk6Q"][/img][/b][/p][p]
Time to kick your grind into overdrive![b] Earn 200% XP for Daily Contracts, and up to 150% XP and Fans for gameplay[/b] from now until the end of the Season![/p][p][/p][h3][b]BIRDS OF A FEATHER? STICK TOGETHER! [/b][/h3][p]Vibing with your team? Take the party into the next match by selecting STAY AS A PARTY at the end of the round! When a match concludes you’ll have the option to vote to keep playing with your same team, forming a party. Who knows - maybe this is the start of a lifelong friendship in The Arena!
[/p][h3][b]JOIN THE OPEN QUALIFIERS![/b][/h3][p][b][img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcYOwDWz04Iumt-3P_GlVmBMDA0KAcFFf0elAPE6saTTVdEBZPY5Uoy-mglEyox3gYv6Himzl8CvQg6OgFI5yts8wxPaHgz7Tp94lQFfjXdURz3Z7f5DtfOK6TJFz_UZBbtvCDtfA?key=Jq8Ev3vznPgfbzKi2UIk6Q"][/img][/b][/p][p]
[b]The road to esports ends in Stockholm, but now - your journey begins.[/b][/p][p]Assemble your team and sign up starting today! [/p][p]This is a global show of skills! Only the bold will rise. Only the best will qualify. [/p][p]It’s time to register your team for the Open Qualifiers! This is your first stop on the road to The Grand Major 2025, our first major tournament for THE FINALS, organized by FACEIT and DREAMHACK, which culminates at Dreamhack Stockholm in November.  

Sign up your team today: [/p][p][url="https://www.reachthefinals.com/registration"]https://www.reachthefinals.com/registration[/url][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]NEW TWITCH DROPS[/b][/h3][p][b][img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdIKV-p3eYFap0Z9EaBBxWkGhy3FxRDjgW_SJlI8GIKsjm0LmcEeoyI57k0QTP8adtxvo-CnoFrpJ2GsXtHtu75V3oGD5gVlCt5ojIEACdgms9jiAoSL8vaI3qDCcFiA2kFfiGgwg?key=Jq8Ev3vznPgfbzKi2UIk6Q"][/img]

[/b]Look out! A new set of fiery purple Twitch Drops. Tune in to get the Broadcast Blaze set of equipment skins![/p][p][/p][h3][b]ONGOING ISSUES WITH FREEZES AND STUTTERING [/b][/h3][p]Over the summer we have been working to identify the issue where some players experience short bursts of stuttering and sometimes even multi-second "freezes" of the client during gameplay. It’s been a challenge to find the root cause, but this week we finally managed to reproduce the issue! This means we are getting closer to finding a permanent solution. [/p][p][/p][p]While we work on figuring out how to eradicate this issue, it’s good to know that the game runs smoother with more memory, so closing any memory-hungry applications (such as Chrome) while playing can help with overall performance. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]STORE [/b][/h3][p]Amongst the latest Store additions, say hello to [b]Hammerhead Ned[/b], suitably accompanied by lightning VFX and monstrous voice effects! Make sure to check out the Store this week![/p][previewyoutube="SWJPtp10s6w;full"][/previewyoutube][p] [/p][h2][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h2][h3][b]Gadgets [/b][/h3][p]Goo Grenade[/p][list][*][p]Cooldown increased from 20s to 30s[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: We’ve noticed the prevalence of goo increasing a little over time, to the point where we think it can now be a little too disruptive to some encounters. This change should reduce the frequency of goo usage slightly [/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Modes[/b][/h3][p]Cashout (World Tour)[/p][list][*][p]Vaults/Cash Boxes that have not been delivered to a Cashout Station by the time overtime starts will no longer despawn, reverting a change made in 7.6. This change only impacts World Tour. In Ranked, Vaults/Cash Boxes that have not been delivered will continue to despawn when overtime starts[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: We’ve been monitoring the 7.6 change and are seeing fewer double-stacked cash boxes (especially Tier 3) and a slight drop in third-party fights. These were both expected outcomes. That said, we’re not fully convinced it’s the right long-term solution. The despawn rule feels more disruptive in World Tour, where team wipe penalties aren’t in play. So for now, we’re disabling it there but keeping it active and under review in Ranked. [/i][/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]Weapons [/b][/h3][p]93R[/p][list][*][p]Decreased rate of fire from 220 to 210, making the weapon slightly slower[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: We’ve been monitoring the 93R since buffing it in update 7.0. The buff improved the weapon considerably, and even made it a touch too strong. We think this small change will better align it with other Light weapons.[/i]
[/p][p]Cerberus 12GA[/p][list][*][p]Decreased the radius of the pellet distribution by approximately 10%, making the weapon more accurate[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the heat applied to world objects by the Cerberus from 2.5 to 7.5, meaning it will now ignite toxic gas clouds in a single shot[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: Since our last round of Cerberus changes the weapon has dropped dramatically in usage across all modes and skill tiers. We want to buff its viability, without returning to its previous overpowered state and we hope these changes will have that effect.    [/i]
[/p][p]Model 1887[/p][list][*][p]Increase maximum ammo capacity from 6 to 7[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: The Model is in a very similar place to the Cerberus, with very low usage and poor performance metrics right now. This subtle change should buff its viability without over-tuning its power.[/i]
[/p][p]Sledgehammer[/p][list][*][p]Secondary attack damage increased from 154 to 175[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: We’re continuing to monitor and adjust the Sledgehammer. This damage buff to the secondary attack will boost its value compared to primary attacks. We’d also like to note we’re aware of some hit registration issues with the Sledeghammer which we’re currently investigating and hope to be able to fix as soon as possible. [/i]
[/p][p]Sword[/p][list][*][p]Increased the vertical component of the secondary attack’s rotation clamping from 40 degrees to 90 degrees, meaning the Sword will not be as constrained when aiming up or down during a lunge attack[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: After recent feedback from players, we’ve relaxed the vertical component of the lunge’s rotation clamping as we agree the vertical clamp was too severe and, in general, vertical movements of the lunge were not what were being exploited previously. Hopefully this feels a lot better, but we’ll continue to read feedback on how players are finding it. [/i]
[/p][h2][b]Content and Bug Fixes 
[/b][/h2][h3][b]Animation [/b][/h3][list][*][p][i]Fixed melee swings sometimes not playing when viewing other Contestants[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where sprint animations would not play correctly after inspecting with certain skins[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where jumping with the Throwing Knives, while using the secondary attack, could cover the center of the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a case where the Riot Shield could desync in third person, not correctly showing the protected state[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: This is the first of several fixes for Riot Shield issues. We’re addressing both animation clarity and cases where the shield’s collision or state can desync from what players see.[/i]
[/p][h3][b]Audio [/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved the quality of Announcer voice lines, and made them less repetitive
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Contracts[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed issue where some damage types were not considered for Contracts involving damage on/from the Power Shift platform [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]
Customization[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed The Devourer eyes showing up on top of glasses[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused some of the older CNS items to have incorrectly displayed prints on them 
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]ESPORTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Updated the Esports section to accommodate new information and registration for the Open Qualifiers. [b]
[/b][i]Dev note: Check out more on the esports format [u][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8-09D02iSOA"]here[/url][/u], and don’t forget to [u][url="https://www.reachthefinals.com/registration"]sign up[/url][/u] to compete in the Open Qualifiers! 
[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Gadgets[/b][/h3][p]H+ Infuser[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where getting eliminated while aiming down sights could result in a broken weapon model[/p][/*][/list][p]Healing Emitter[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Contestants were not healed by their team’s Healing Emitter while holding an enemy team’s Healing Emitter[/p][/*][/list][p]Nullifier[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where nullified opponents could deal quick melee damage
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused kill hitmarkers to be missing in certain situations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a hit-reg issue with KS-23 and SR-84[/p][/*][*][p]Updated respawn statue collision to behave more predictably and reduce rolling on sloped surfaces
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Maps[/b][/h3][p]General[/p][list][*][p]Larger trees now have sturdier trunks that require more bullets to destroy, making them more reliable for cover and line of sight blocking[/p][/*][/list][p]Practice Range[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the trophy leaderboard text could be difficult to read when picked up[/p][/*][*][p]Added Blast Off and Super Cashball trophies[/p][/*][/list][p]Bernal[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a zipline on top of the Chapel that floated after the geometry beneath it was destroyed[/p][/*][*][p]Updated collision on corrugated metal modules to prevent objectives from visually appearing through the roof and being interactable[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for collision issue of railing piece, specifically causing movement issues around residential staircases[/p][/*][/list][p]Monaco[/p][list][*][p]Fixed some visual gaps in ground meshes[/p][/*][/list][p]Seoul:[/p][list][*][p]Slightly raised the vent path on the outside of Apartments so you can smoothly walk over the ledge at the end without snagging[/p][/*][/list][p]Skyway Stadium[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where grenades and bullets could pass through a narrow part of  the back of the Office building[/p][/*][/list][p]SYS$Horizon[/p][list][*][p]Updated the Library building with the latest destruction systems [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a step being too high on the voxel bridge next to campus which caused players to snag[/p][/*][/list][p]Nozomi/Citadel[/p][list][*][p]Added trees at the edges around the Cybercafe to block sightlines towards the corner next to Apartments[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a duplicate desk underneath another desk in the Operations Center
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Private Matches & Spectator[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved layout and visuals for the match building screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could end up in a corrupted private match lobby
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Rendering[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added support for AMD FSR 3 Frame Generation[/p][/*][*][p]Pause DLSS Frame Generation when in fullscreen menus (except Video Settings), to avoid rendering artifacts on UI elements[/p][/*][*][p]Updated AMD FSR version from 3.1.3 to 3.1.4[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing light leaking in fog[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized GPU performance when a lot of visual effects are active[/p][/*][*][p]Removed a command line that could give unfair advantages by lowering graphical fidelity
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Settings[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented gamepads/controllers from working when Steam Input is enabled
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Social[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed mouse scroll wheel functioning poorly with the text chat window[/p][/*][*][p]Added Stay as a Party functionality to end of round screen[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: Long requested and finally in THE FINALS - you can now opt in to form a party with the team members of your last game, right at the end of round screen![/i]
[/p][h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]XBOX platform avatars are now properly shown as your profile image where applicable[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where only item names were shown instead of descriptions in outfit customization[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect game mode name being shown in the tab scoreboard when reconnecting after shutting down the game[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved issue causing new markers to appear on other outfits after deleting an outfit[/p][/*][*][p]The Contracts screen now properly retains the selected tab when navigating back from other pages[/p][/*][*][p]Fix rewards flow screen getting into a blank state when hitting next/skip too quickly[/p][/*][*][p]Fix text chat sometimes staying on-screen after being closed during gameplay
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Security [/b][/h3][p]New update and exciting news from the Anti-Cheat team![/p][p]With this release we will perform a technical test of Denuvo Anti Cheat on Xbox for Windows. If the test goes well, we'll consider rolling it out incrementally on Steam in Season 8.[/p][p]We'd also like to point out that we're not utilizing the Digital Rights Management parts of the Denuvo platform.
[/p][p]Compatibility with SteamDeck and Proton has been tested as well, and we are still committed to serving that part of our community.
[/p][p]Please keep sending in player reports and other information you believe could be of value to us, it really helps us in our work to keep THE FINALS fair and secure!
[/p][p]//Tom and Magnum[/p]

notes.title: Update 7.8
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE 7.8.0 – RISK & REWARD RETURNS[/h1][p][b]Sponsored by VAIIYA, the Risk & Reward World Tour is back, and this time, the stakes are smarter.[/b][/p][p]Throughout the event, Contestants will earn varying amounts of cash for eliminations based on the Weapon used. Whether you go in with a surgeon’s precision or a showman’s flair, the right tool could mean the difference between pocket change or a payload.[/p][p]With rebalanced cash earned per elimination, it’s the perfect time to rethink your Loadout and bring your most devious strategies to the Arena.[/p][p]So go bold, go calculated.. just don’t go in unprepared.[/p][previewyoutube="qAxTUscFJfg;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Looking to turn heads [i]while[/i] you turn the tide of battle? Consider yourself Judge, Jury and Executioner? The store has been restocked with high-contrast, high-drama looks. Face off in black-and-white with Mandatum Nullum and Mandatum Ultimum, or flash feathers and firepower with the Aviatrix Prime Load, a dual pistol set crafted in the spirit of light and shadow. The Marble Monarch and Marble Mobster sets round out the drop with sculpted strength and museum-grade menace.
[/p][previewyoutube="sf1yKYZ1DVk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]And if you’ve been waiting for news on the Grand Major 2025, the time has come. Today at 16:00 CEST, we’re revealing the full competitive format, including a breakdown video, detailed blog, and complete rulebook.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Update 7.7
notes.content:
[h1]Update 7.7.0 – Badoom and Bancho[/h1][p]This week, it’s all about the style.[/p][p]We’re bringing a plush-powered punch to the Arena with the arrival of the ÖRF BADOOM! Mythic Frag Grenade skin. Soft, snarky, and seriously explosive, just pull the cord and let it do the talking.[/p][p]The Bancho Rising outfit also enters the spotlight this week. This legendary look brings the attitude and swagger of a street legend straight into the Arena. All leather. No mercy.[/p][p]Looking for something more tactical? The Mayhem Threat Set is here with a stripped-down, stockless AKM skin that blends lethal intent with sleek design. Minimalist, mean, and made to make a statement.[/p][previewyoutube="U58kxe46w8g;full"][/previewyoutube][p]On the fixes and improvements side of things, we have enabled support for spectators in Cash Ball Private Matches! There is a bug where everyone is wearing the same colored outfit, but you can still tell players apart through their outline and the color of their health bars!
[/p][h2]Introducing the Embark Creator Program[/h2][p]Ready for some egg-citing news?[/p][p]We know that many of you have been asking and waiting for this, and we can finally announce that we have officially launched the Embark Creator Program! You can now go from a Contestant to a Rising Star as an Embark Creator or Partner, and we want to be part of your journey![/p][p][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62d66fa29e72c560f8efc020/d2b49fb4-7eaa-43c1-ab29-ee854dbff89e/image+%2840%29.png?format=2500w"][/img][/p][p][url="https://reachthefinals.com/creator-program"]Find all the information you need here[/url]![/p][p]
~ From Caroline and the ECP Team, with love![/p]

notes.title: Mid-Season update 7.6 - SUPER CASHBALL!
notes.content:
[h1][b]QUEUE UP FOR SUPER CASHBALL! [/b][/h1][p][img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcPbAotvT2axpqs2fvh1OSBPtsBZ_36rl_kxNjX-oemkGp4VJEic1ScT6zavIT5nohzp6BRmBh567hI0NF1QTsc_oP34U8dttVQluIJ-nj5XtQWOR7pn_QOLUpjVi5xYZaOw-ZzhA?key=SxBi7qH8TMstbS-ooqY30Q"][/img][/p][p]Hit the locker room Contestants, it’s time to suit up for SUPER CASHBALL! [/p][p]Welcome to the fast-paced, high-stakes 5v5 mode where you work as a team to throw the Cashball into the opposing goal! You can score even bigger by passing the ball between teammates, charging the ball and making it worth even more points! Earn up to 3 points in a single goal with a fully charged Cashball! A pass counts even if the ball touches the ground, so long as the next person who grabs it is on the same team.[/p][p]The match is split into two five-minute halves with a short halftime in between. At the final buzzer, if the ball is still in the air, it can still score, so those last-second throws are very much in play. Every second counts in CA$HBALL STADIUM.[/p][p]Looking for a comeback? Score in the last 30 seconds to get an extra 30 seconds on the timer! If a tie, the first team that reached the tied score will win.[/p][p][b]Choose your position wisely! [/b]Loadouts are locked and the best team has a balance: [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="229,,"][tr][td colwidth="229"][p][b]Light Build: Strikers 
[/b]Deadly with the Dagger and fast on their feet. They can subdue opponents, and get across the Stadium in a flash![/p][/td][td][p][b]Medium Build: Playmaker [/b][/p][p]This position will escort the ball, pluck it out of the sky with the Winch, and carry the whole team across the field!  [/p][/td][td][p][b]Heavy Build: Enforcer [/b][/p][p]Lock down the ball and the goal or chase the opposing team back to their own territory, usually in coin form. [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="229"][p][b]Loadout: 
[/b]Evasive Dash 
Dagger
Glitch Grenade [b]
[/b]Thermal Bore
Nullifier [/p][/td][td][p][b]Loadout: 
[/b]Winch Claw
Riot Shield
Goo Grenade
Jump Pad
Zipline[/p][/td][td][p][b]Loadout: 
[/b]Charge n Slam
Sledgehammer
Barricade
Dome Shield
Lockbolt[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]Each goal has a penalty zone around it, and if a player from the opposing team steps inside, they get Glitched. A Glitched player can’t pick up or carry the ball, nor can they use Gadgets or Specializations. So watch where you step and don’t get baited into the enemy zone! [/p][p][b]Success in SUPER CASHBALL is all about teamwork.[/b] Pass to charge, watch the zones, and always be ready to launch that final shot. [/p][p]SUPER CASHBALL will be available in Private Matches, as well! And keep an eye out for the leaderboard!  [/p][h2][b]CA$HBALL STADIUM 
[/b][img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXemCIjFC5NlY4ipilyFO0lB2575opTG-9PSxh5XjC_dFMzHRzqvUAS5nRVXUUQ3rCsgBr5tm6NbIWYvgipL3L_fm8Kqr-xVaKd8Qqkx0wz_HZJyIETpRNi86YuGS9-nGc8wf-afjw?key=SxBi7qH8TMstbS-ooqY30Q"][/img][/h2][p]All of this goes down in a brand new Arena: CA$HBALL STADIUM! The lights are up, the playing field is ready. [/p][h2][b]SPIN THE SUPER CASHBALL WHEEL[/b][/h2][p][img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdvfwx6K78WIq8Ob0B6mn2xHIWuyg56hj0CnQh9MaqqfE5qoulgcW9-_mJ5xdOWAnQSZ59UZWrginxEvdIsxWuMbKwT88xlsVEskb_ddLVi8dPxzch_2bltz56hKdkEWjfl87WH?key=SxBi7qH8TMstbS-ooqY30Q"][/img][/p][p]From our generous Seasonal Sponsor, VAIIYA, we introduce the SUPER CASHBALL WHEEL! It comes with CASHBALL-themed prizes, with each a chance to be earned by completing Daily Contracts to get tickets! Everyone gets a free ticket to start and duplicate spins will get you a ticket part. Combine three ticket parts to make a new ticket for an additional spin. 
[/p][p]You’ve got 20 prizes up for grabs and the [b]Zone Enforcer Set[/b] at the end if you successfully unlock them all! 
[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf1Ydc0xpXljNKWdqMLN3KH0-sYB1YH0vqfkxI_nqwCOIOyGLlExtoTQVtxSLKsW3wd_Vh0Bl6Wm4tKRk_FkcWigBZBY0nz3H_3QJ4GYU253h1urQUmQZ6HxI_EHXn68PNGNFmzgQ?key=SxBi7qH8TMstbS-ooqY30Q"][/img][/p][h2][b]CUSTOMIZE YOUR COMMS [/b][/h2][p]You can now pick how your Contestant sounds in the Arena, separate from the Face you have chosen, with the all new Voice Customization feature in the Appearance Tab. Some voices come with custom voice lines![/p][p]We still have some voice altering effects attached to certain items and those will still work, regardless of the voice you have chosen.[/p][h2][b]CHUCK THE HEALING EMITTER [/b][/h2][p][img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXehULlvaBuPCmpno7e9C7zT0QvBpnv4d7-5djdSfnwqrus9v4Z_7tSgxuGUjLwCuNHLVpxnvALyZNL0u9uuhUs7fw7BNx1Ege7xRykfHpRQ_8bV7jnW7krpFJzC4bhL5pW953P8Iw?key=SxBi7qH8TMstbS-ooqY30Q"][/img][/p][p]This update comes with CASHBALLS and Wheels, so why not throw one more round thing into the mix! Our brand new Twitch drops campaign will start today, and you’ll be able to earn Chuck the Ball! You’ll also get the Chuck nametag sticker, and a Chuck Charm, so even when you play Light and Medium, he’ll be by your side! [/p][p]All you need to do is tune in to any streamer playing in THE FINALS category and watch to earn! Make sure you have connected your Twitch account so you don’t miss out on your new best bud! [/p][h2][b]LOTUS REAPER SET + 2400 MB [/b][/h2][p][img src="https://lh7-qw.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeYw8TyW1vFwEe-sY2lye5NXJasDdiWhbphWZIBZyhm9j-ftP3LDkwc6qU6TG6TFo0DzXV2H7cXan1TZN39_RjfKbOymWHo6M0I76INnQgcJTRBtW-Hn53cRfcldlfnbNBOnAQHjg?key=SxBi7qH8TMstbS-ooqY30Q"][/img]
The [b]Lotus Reaper Set[/b] has arrived and it comes [b]with 2400 Multibucks[/b], and some of the most [b]striking pieces[/b] we have seen in the Arena to date! Bloom in silence, [b]strike without mercy[/b]![/p][p][/p][h2][b]STORE UPDATE [/b][/h2][p]Some moments in The Arena deserve to be recorded, and watched back, in beautiful 8mm quality - and now you can with the Overexposed FAMAS![/p][p]Check it, and much more, out in this week’s store:[/p][previewyoutube="HBx459K6vGY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][b]SERVER CRASH EXPLOIT [/b][/h2][p]In some serious news, we have patched a critical exploit that allowed players to crash the servers. We’ve managed to compile a list of everyone who used this deliberate exploit in order to remove other players from the game. [/p][p]We’ll be returning the lost RS to players who were affected by this in a Ranked Tournament and permanently banning those who used this exploit to wreak havoc in the last few days. Game breaking exploits are serious and performing them deliberately is not permitted. [/p][p]To those impacted by this exploit, we’re sorry for the inconvenience and we appreciate all the reports that helped us identify the issue and ensure it could be stopped. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]A note on Melee from Design Director, Matt: [/b][/h2][p]We wanted to share an update on the state of melee, since it's been a hot topic in the community lately. The goal is to clarify how we see melee and what kind of work we’re doing to improve it going forward.[/p][p]First and foremost, melee weapons belong in THE FINALS. We wouldn’t have added them if that weren’t the case. For a melee weapon to earn its place, it needs to be viable as a style of play, intuitive for both the user and the opponent, and feel like the kills it gets are earned. Let’s break that down.[/p][h3][b]Viability [/b][/h3][p]In order to make melee weapons viable, they should be able to compete with fairly similar odds to guns, but that doesn’t mean they should always be as good as the best gun or other weapons. In a game with so many weapons of incredibly varied styles, some will always be more accessible and others more niche, that’s the reality of building weapons that are so asymmetric to one another. Melee weapons, shotguns, sniper rifles and bows tend to be more niche because they exist at the extremes of balance: very short or very long ranges, very fast or very slow fire rates, etc. This makes them notoriously hard to balance. They’re often underpowered, but when buffed can quickly become overpowered and frustrating to play against. This is just the nature of balancing for more extreme playstyles. Our goal to keep them viable is to make sure players have a chance to win without making them overly frustrating or too niche for regular play. It’s a hard goal to hit, thus we keep working toward it. 
[/p][h3][b]Intuitiveness [/b][/h3][p]For melee weapons to be intuitive, they need to behave in a way that most players can easily understand and expect, especially new players. This is where ‘melee tech’ comes in.  At its core, ‘Tech’ means discovering and using bugs and edge cases in the game’s code and design. Most FPS tech arises where one system meets another. For example, the Sword’s “super lunge” is the result of one movement system (the Evasive Dash) meeting another (the lunge). Likewise, the “phantom strike” tech exploits bugs and edge cases in our animation system to perform melee strikes without visible animations. We get this can be fun to discover and master, because it boosts a weapon’s power and often takes skill. But for others, it’s frustrating. It’s unintuitive, often invisible, and disproportionately strong. [/p][p]Our position on ‘tech’ has been clear since our Alpha and Beta, where we discussed ‘movement tech’ in our[url="https://open.spotify.com/show/5OehdZdePuUwWUS0Og9cvQ"][u] [i]Meet the Makers[/i][/u][/url] podcast. We see ‘tech’ as a bug. When it disrupts balance or frustrates players, we aim to fix it, and in severe cases, may ban players who repeatedly exploit it. Occasionally, ‘tech’ emerges that is intuitive and doesn’t  break balance. In those rare cases, we may turn the ‘tech’ into an actual mechanic that is part of the game, but only if it fits. At the end of the day though, ‘tech’ is unintended and frequently harmful to the overall experience of the game.
[/p][h3][b]Current Melee Tech [/b][/h3][p]Some recent ‘melee tech’ has put us in a tough spot. Without the tech, some items can feel underpowered, and with it, they become overpowered and frustrating to play against. [/p][p]We want to remove that ‘tech’ for the reasons explained above, but sometimes the work involved with re-writing a system can take a long time. So what then should we do with the frustration it’s causing in the interim? This is a tough problem to solve. Generally, we’ve solved this by nerfing the item in question while the ‘tech’ exists, until we have time to fix it properly, at which point we can re-buff the weapons. That is part of the journey the Sword has been through in recent months. It’s been nerfed to offset some ‘tech’ that was frustrating and making the Sword overly punishing to play against, while we made changes to its functionality. With 7.6, new functionality goes into the game that should address the ‘tech’ issue, allowing us to buff the Sword again. With the new functionality we can monitor how well the Sword does and go from there.[/p][p]Outside of the ‘tech’ issues, we’re aware that a lot of the melee weapons still lack the refinement of our guns and that’s something we want to tackle in the long-term. In 7.6, we’re making a number of balance changes to try and smooth out some of the lumps these items have, but many of them still need considerable re-works to get them to the best place possible for both their users and opponents. Re-works take time. We’re hopeful we can deliver a number of these in the coming seasons, but in the meantime we’ll continue to do what we can by balancing within our current systems. 

Hopefully this gives you a better understanding of how we see melee and our approach to it. We also hope this explanation goes some way to explaining the various melee changes made in 7.6. As always, keep providing feedback and we’ll keep trying our hardest to be as solid and varied for different playstyles as we can.  [/p][p]
//Matt

After doing a detailed analysis, it’s clear that the biggest frustration point is doubling the Cash Boxes during the final phase, where the total value of a single Cashout can be huge. In this scenario, the second-place team almost always loses their spot, since all three other teams are incentivized to target them. The first place wants a weaker opponent next round, while third and fourth just want to qualify. Our data shows that regardless how much cash the second place team has already secured, this doubling scenario always disproportionately affects them negatively. It often occurs during overtime as well. This change is aimed at making sure second place teams that have already secured a lot of cash are more likely to qualify, by reducing how often large stacks of cash are available in the final Cashout during overtime. [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Security [/b][/h3][p]With update 7.3, we mentioned changes coming to our anti-cheat systems, and a few questions popped up in response. So we thought we’d take this update to give you a bit more information: [/p][p][b]Kernel-Level Anti-Cheat Isn’t New[/b][/p][p]Easy Anti-Cheat is a kernel-level program, and it’s been implemented in THE FINALS since early betas. However, we’re currently testing additional anti-cheat tools to collect feedback on what’s best for the game long-term. There’s no set timeline here, but we’re obviously cautious not to disrupt the game while testing and planning. [/p][p]Modern cheats use advanced methods, including external hardware and AI, that target the game from the outside in ways that are hard to detect. To effectively protect the experience for fair players, we need anti-cheat tools that can see what’s interacting with the game process directly on the player’s computer.[/p][p]We understand privacy concerns. Our anti-cheat is focused solely on identifying threats to the game. We do not collect information about your personal files, nor do we monitor unrelated activity. [/p][p][b]Steam Deck and Proton Support[/b][/p][p]We noticed the concern about Linux following our last update. We’re testing everything across all platforms, and have made it very clear to our partners that Proton and Steam Deck are important to our development plans. While we don’t officially support Steam Deck due to our required dependence on Proton Experimental, we are committed to ensuring compatibility, and we work with external partners to fix issues before we ship a patch. The experience of every player is important to us. Despite many factors, we are still dedicated to supporting it because we know it matters. However, general Wine support is not tested, and native Linux support is not planned. [/p][p]Thank you for your continuous support. We’ll have more to share in the next major update! 

//Chim and Tom [/p]

notes.content:

notes.content:
